title: pulse
tagline: Turns crowd predictions into real-time, precise market signals
description:
We’re building a new kind of next-gen prediction platform that goes beyond the usual “will it go up or down?” Instead, users can predict exact price ranges, creating a real-time picture of market sentiment.
What makes our platform different is that each prediction is represented as ERC-721 standard NFT, making it  tradable, and programmable. Combined with dynamic pricing, the market adapts instantly to collective sentiment, rewarding users for accurate forecasts. This way, crowd opinions aren’t just guesses—they’re powerful, actionable insights that can guide smarter decisions.
how_its_made:
Architecture 
1. The core logic, market creation, probability updates, and NFT-based position management are all on-chain.
2.Serving market data, handling user interactions, and integrating off-chain computations for efficiency.
3.NFTs (ERC-721) to represent user positions: Every prediction is an NFT that encodes stake, price range, and payout potential.
4.Segment Trees & Fixed-Point Math Libraries: For efficient probability calculations across multiple price ranges, ensuring real-time updates with minimal gas and computation overhead.
5.CLMSRMarketCore handles probability updates dynamically as more users participate, using LazyMulSegTree for fast computations.
6.When the market resolves, payouts are calculated based on probability-weighted rewards and distributed automatically.
